description.fun: Aron eats iron ore to build its steel body, and when it gets really hungry it comes down from the mountains to munch on bridges and railway tracks. It makes a new suit of armour every time it evolves, and people have collected its shed armour to recycle into iron goods since ancient times. One all-out charge can wreck a heavy dump truck.
description.guide: A Steel- and Rock-type Pokémon that lives in the mountains, eats iron ore and wears plates of steel armour, possibly inspired by Bulgasari, the iron-eating monster of Korean legend. It evolves into Lairon at level 32.
description.tagline: A tiny armoured eater of iron ore, bridges and railway tracks

description.fun: Lairon settles territorial disputes by ramming its steel body into rivals, and shows off by charging into rocks to see how big the sparks are. Its armour is covered in scratches and dents from all those clashes. It nests in mountains where iron ore is buried, which has led to fights with human miners and with other Lairon.
description.guide: A Steel- and Rock-type Pokémon covered in plates of iron armour, which drinks mineral spring water and eats the iron in rocks. It evolves from Aron at level 32 and into Aggron at level 42.
description.tagline: A brawling iron-eater that shows off with sparks

description.fun: Aggron wears the gouges in its armour as mementos, so the more scars it has, the more battles it has fought, and its horns grow a little at a time, so they show its age. It fiercely guards a whole mountain as its territory, and if a flood or fire damages it, Aggron hauls in topsoil and plants trees to restore it. Long ago, a king wore an Aggron-shaped helmet hoping to borrow its strength.
description.guide: A huge, heavily armoured Steel- and Rock-type Pokémon that claims a mountain as its territory. It evolves from Lairon at level 42 and is the final form of Aron. It can Mega Evolve with the Aggronite.
description.tagline: An armoured mountain guardian that replants its land after disasters

description.fun: Mega Evolution spreads Aggron's steel armour over its entire body and adds a third, wider horn on its nose, said to be able to destroy a steel tank. Mega Aggron sheds its Rock type to become pure Steel, one of only two dual-type Pokémon that lose a type when they Mega Evolve, and its Defense ties Shuckle's as the highest of any obtainable Pokémon.
